extract_answer_from_text: extract a boxed answer from LLM output text that contains LaTeX boxed notation
compute_confidence_from_logprobs: compute confidence scores from vLLM token logprobs and return a list of float values
simple_majority_vote: perform simple majority voting on a list of string answers and return the most common one
weighted_majority_vote: perform weighted majority voting on answers using confidence weights to select the best answer
compute_all_voting_results: compute results for all voting methods including majority, weighted, and filtered confidence voting on traces
